extension.description: Display current time, current temperature and media playing time remaining on a YoctoMaxiDisplay screen.
extension.news:
v0.2.9 - Renamed the addon to "YoctoDisplay" (was "Kodi YoctoDisplay") - addon ID is unchanged
v0.2.8 - Update vendored Yoctopuce SDK (2.1.6320 to 2.1.15129) - Keep retrying to connect indefinitely - picks up the display whenever it's plugged in, and recovers automatically if disconnected mid-session, instead of giving up after one failed attempt - Notifications now include the actual error, not just "see logs" - Properly release the Yocto API on shutdown/profile switch, and don't crash if the display disappears mid-session - Brightness/LED setting changes now apply live, without needing a restart - Fix display orientation being wrong at boot (including the Yoctopuce boot logo) - self-corrects and saves to the device's flash once, rather than every startup - Narrow the Linux ARM library-selection override (was forcing 'armhf' on any non-Windows platform, not just 32-bit ARM)

extension.summary: Patch Kodi skins for OzWeather Radar Support.
extension.description: Supports: Estuary (& Plextuary), Estouchy, Confluence, A Confluence Zeitgeist, Xonfluence, OSMC, Amber, Aeon (Nox Silvo and Tajo) - This addon attempts to patch Kodi skins for OzWeather radar support. - By default, will auto-patch your skin every time a new version of the skin arrives. - Skin folder **must be writeable!** - Creates a backup of the original skin files first and this addon can also restore those if need be). - By default, patches only the actual weather page. - For Estuary & Confluence, this also patches your VideoFullScreen file for weather during playback when video info is displayed.
extension.news:
v0.5.10 - Fix malformed default background opacity value - Fix restore not sticking - could be silently undone by the next auto-patch run - Fix crash if OzWeather isn't installed/enabled when patching - Manually running the patcher on a bossanova808 skin no longer touches its files (matches auto-patch behaviour) - Escape user-configured colours before writing them into skin XML - Tighten skin detection & make the auto-patch delay respond promptly to Kodi shutting down
v0.5.9 - Improve logging and threading

extension.summary: Bossanova808 mod of Confluence skin, originally by Jezz_X & Team Kodi. Various tidy-ups and visual tweaks, OzWeather and ClearArt support built in.
extension.description: Bossanova808 mod of Confluence skin, originally by Jezz_X & Team Kodi. Various tidy-ups and visual tweaks, OzWeather and ClearArt support built in.
extension.news:
v5.0.928 - Fix fast profile switching not working for the "Adults HDD"/"Kids HDD" profiles - fell back to a full logout instead - Remove unused "- Away" profile switching entries
v5.0.927 - Add comprehensive PlayerProcessInfo (PPI) dialog: detailed video/audio/system info, plus Dolby Vision metadata and Amlogic processing details on p3i/AM6B+ hardware - Add codec/HDR/Dolby Vision badge overlays on video start, in the OSD, and in the PlayerProcessInfo dialog - Add graceful fallback to real Kodi values (or a clean "N/A") for PPI info fields on Windows/non-Amlogic platforms, instead of blank or garbled text - Fix codec badges never actually appearing on screen - the file defining them was never registered with the skin engine - Fix ClearArt/thumbnail overlapping the PlayerProcessInfo dialog - Add "p3i Extras" section to skin settings: codec logo duration (numeric entry, default 3s) and position (Left/Center/Right, default Top Left) for startup/OSD/PPI badges
